notes: Posted 5 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards (the post looks ahead to Coruscant), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'start (7)': You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed (posted 'Profit/ you dont even have to flip to win'), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol and Boonta Eve Podrace; these count toward the 60. Podrace Prep is listed under Interrupts and Goo Nee Tay under Effects ('mostly start').
The line 'purple' under the starting section is a sub-heading, not a card; I Did It! listed below it counts toward the 60.
Posted 'han with blaster' (twice, the second 'besides the one you start') dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (the EPP Han, per the strategy text).
Posted 'sense & uncertain is the future' (the Dark combo) dested the Light combo Sense & Recoil In Fear; the strategy counts '5 senses'.

Posted 'qui-gons saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is a later Reflections III card); 'Jabbas palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (Special Edition); 'luke with saber', 'obi with saber' and 'lando with axe' dested the Enhanced Premiere characters.

The description and strategy mention the Belgian Open (built two days before it) and the Swedish Open (won 'by alex tennet'); no finish is given for this player, so the deck is listed as a general DeckTech post.
